entries.title: II Corinthians 5:1
segments: For we know that if our earthly house of [this] tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:2
segments: For indeed in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed with our dwelling-place out of Heaven;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:3
segments: if indeed [in] being clothed, we shall not be found naked.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:4
segments: For we who are in [this] tabernacle groan, being burdened; inasmuch as we do not wish to be unclothed, but to be clothed, so that the mortal might be swallowed up by the life.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:5
segments: And He who has worked in us for this same thing [is] God, who also [is] giving to us the earnest of the Spirit.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:6
segments: Then being always confident, knowing that while we are at home in the body, we are away from home from the Lord;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:7
segments: for we walk by faith, not by sight;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:8
segments: then we are confident and we are pleased rather to go away from home out of the body, and to come home to the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:9
segments: Therefore we are also laboring to be well-pleasing to Him, whether at home or away from home.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:10
segments: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive the things [done] in his body, according to that which he has done, whether good or bad.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:11
segments: Therefore, knowing the terror of the Lord, we persuade men. But we are revealed to God, and I trust also that we are revealed in your consciences.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:12
segments: For we do not commend ourselves again to you, but are giving you occasion to glory on our behalf, so that you may have [it] to [answer those] boasting in appearance, and not in heart.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:13
segments: For if we are out of our mind, [it is] to God; or [if] we are in our senses, [it is] for you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:14
segments: For the love of Christ constrains us, judging this, that if one died for all, then all died;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:15
segments: and He died for all, that the living ones may live no more to themselves, but to Him who died for them having been raised.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:16
segments: So as we now know no one according to flesh, but even if we have known Christ according to flesh, yet now we no longer know [Him] so.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:17
segments: So that if any one [is] in Christ, [that one is] a new creature; old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:18
segments: And all things [are] of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:19
segments: whereas God was in Christ reconciling [the] world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and putting the word of reconciliation in us.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:20
segments: Then we are ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as God exhorting through us, we beseech [you] on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

entries.title: II Corinthians 5:21
segments: For He has made Him who knew no sin, [to be] sin for us, that we might become [the] righteousness of God in Him.
